pages.title: Jupiter
pages.text: The largest planet in the Solar System. It is a gas giant, so you cannot land: it stays on the map. Land on its moons instead. They take a tier 4 rocket.

pages.title: Io
pages.text: The most volcanic world in the Solar System. Gravity is about 35% of Earth's. It has copper, sulfur, volcanic ore, and lava and sulfur geysers. The boss is a huge ghast, and its tier 5 key opens the treasure room.

pages.title: Europa
pages.text: An icy moon with an ocean under its shell. Gravity is about 22% of Earth's. It has emeralds, silicon and aluminum, plus geysers, including underwater ones. The surface is cold. Europa's brown ice is needed for the tier 5 oxygen tank.

pages.title: Ganymede
pages.text: The largest moon in the Solar System, bigger than Mercury. Gravity is about 29% of Earth's. It has magnesium and ilmenite. There is no air and it is cold, so thermal protection is a must. Ganymede stone goes into the heavy plate of the tier 6 rocket.

pages.title: Callisto
pages.text: An old, crater-covered distant moon. Gravity is about 32% of Earth's. It is as cold as Jupiter's other moons. It has no special ores, but Callisto stone is needed for the heavy plate of the tier 5 rocket.
